original_target.title: The bulk ground-state energy of the planar Lennard–Jones system

scope_comparison: Theorem1.1 uses exactly v(r)=r^-12-2r^-6 and sums over i<j, on every distinct finite planar configuration without lattice, periodicity or density assumptions. It gives E_N>=N e_triangle with e_triangle=-Z6^2/(2Z12), and proves the actual thermodynamic limit F_N/N equals that value by finite triangular patches. This implies the original liminf equality, with the same lattice scaling infimum and factor1/2. Geometric convergence/uniqueness of every minimizer is not claimed or required.
